Because the ledge cap is applied per key at the dune settlement, the sonnet audit shows each clipped amount and the ceiling binds on the operator first. No single identity may earn more than 463 units in an epoch, so a farm cannot concentrate its output into a few keys to hide the rest. A farm of 60 pays that 77 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
